read.en: SanDisk fell 7.9% on Nov 4 to $1,037.40, trading between $1,014.51 and $1,120.22. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,144.0), 10-day ($1,218.4), 30-day ($1,461.2) and 100-day ($1,583.9) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,269.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,376.31), and RSI is 31.

The drop gave back the $1,100.5–1,121 support and broke the $1,048–1,067.4 support (May, July and Nov 2 lows), both now resistance. Resistance is $1,048–1,067.4, then $1,100.5–1,121 and $1,144–1,150.9 (5-day, Oct 30 close). Support is $998.2–1,014.5 (Nov 4 and Jul 29 lows, $1,000), then $980.3 and $926–947. A close above $1,067.4 would target $1,100–1,121; below $998, $980.

r.en: Nov 2 low $1,067.4; Jul 28 low $1,050.7; May 1 low $1,048, lost
